g.text: Fig. 15. Evidence landscape for fruit yield (TRAIN unless stated). (a) Independent studies per stress class × biostimulant class (du Jardin v2
classes; a study testing two classes counts in both). (b) Yield effect: bold = DESCRIPTIVE pooled mean with 95 % CR2 CI (rma.mv, ≥ 3 studies); grey
italics in brackets = descriptive median of study means (< 3 studies, no interval). (c) For cells with ≥ 3 studies the grey bar is the 95 % prediction
interval for a NEW study and the cross is the mean out-of-fold PREDICTION of the selected a-priori model; descriptive means and predictions are
